title: nvidia-smi Output Reader
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Read six outlined fields of an nvidia-smi listing and choose what each one reports.

learningObjectives: The learner will interpret 6 highlighted fields of an `nvidia-smi` listing by choosing what each one reports, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: The memory field ends in MiB. Work out the total in GiB and explain why it is not the same number in GB.
commonMisconceptions: The CUDA version is the toolkit installed on the machine.
The power figure is the whole machine's draw.
A figure in MiB is the same as one in MB.
A GPU at 0% utilization is not working correctly.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
